# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A wide opening range (OR) with strong early-volume imbalance predicts continuation of the breakout direction beyond the first 30 minutes. The edge exists because institutional order flow often imbalances during the open, creating a vacuum that price continues to fill when volume confirms conviction. This captures momentum before mean-reversion traps chop the move.

## Mechanism

Define OR as high-low of first two 5-minute bars (09:30-09:40). Compute OR_midpoint = (OR_high + OR_low)/2. If (OR_high - OR_low) > 0.5% of OR_midpoint AND volume in first 5-minute bar > 1.5× average 5-minute volume of prior 20 bars, then:  
- Go long on close above OR_high + 0.1% of price  
- Go short on close below OR_low - 0.1% of price (same volume condition)  
Exit: Stop at opposite OR boundary (OR_low for long, OR_high for short). TP1 at 1.5× risk. Runner trails using 15%-of-HWM trailing stop. Regime filter: Only active when VIX > 18 and time between 09:45-10:30; avoid when VIX < 12.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L due to 50% risk cap and 3-contract minimum.  
2. **Sample bias:** Proposed logic uses OR definition and volume filters; no historical sample tested yet. High overfit risk due to multiple parameters (OR width threshold, volume multiplier, entry offset, exit rules).  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation of top 3 J days against realistic OPRA slippage model).  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw in low-VIX chop (<12) triggering false breakouts; max drawdown scenario: consecutive losses during VIX mean-reversion regimes; blow-up: volatility explosion widening OR beyond stop distance causing gap-through.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute if top-5 days exceed 20% of P&L.
